purpose: Project unresolved continuity identifiers into a source-class-aware knowledge graph without reconstructing missing history.
sources_inspected: File Library relevance-ranked searches for exact M-004, M-005, and M-006 continuity identifiers

durable_memory.title: Search results are evidence objects, not identity assignments
durable_memory.rule: A candidate may resolve a provenance gap only when its exact identifier, namespace, owner, semantic role, temporal precedence, and immutable locator agree. Relevance-ranked absence cannot establish nonexistence, and suffix matches remain collision evidence only.
durable_memory.graph_effect: Every continuity identifier node carries source_class, verification_status, claim_status, coverage_class, privacy_class, and falsification_route. Promotion to authoritative_memory requires an immutable assigning source.

source_class_vocabulary.authoritative_memory: Immutable source explicitly assigns the exact continuity identifier and satisfies namespace, owner, semantic-role, and temporal checks.
source_class_vocabulary.run_report_lead: Narrative or automation output reports the identifier but is not repository persistence proof.
source_class_vocabulary.namespace_collision: Observed source shares a numeric suffix or fuzzy similarity but belongs to a different namespace or semantic role.
source_class_vocabulary.negative_search_observation: A bounded or relevance-ranked search did not locate the identifier; this records coverage only and cannot prove nonexistence.

coverage_limit: Repository connector search and File Library retrieval are not exhaustive branch-history proofs. This projection verifies classification and quarantine state, not nonexistence.
privacy_boundary: Only opaque identifiers, source classes, repository metadata, and abstract semantic classifications are persisted. No private dialogue, personal events, health information, credentials, or identifying details are reproduced.
